# uv overrides that reproduce the GraphCast container (containers/graphcast.dockerfile) in a pip
# environment: earth2studio pins an older graphcast commit, the container replaces it with this one;
# cfgrib is earth2studio's own git pin, which uv needs listed directly; SwissClim at the pinned commit
# needs pandas 2 (pandas 3 breaks its by-lead tables), the version of the container and the host venv.
# Use: uv pip install -e ".[graphcast]" --override env/graphcast-overrides.txt
graphcast @ git+https://github.com/google-deepmind/graphcast@08cf73625c9d12bd9aaa038868bcb2fe488f2a22
cfgrib @ git+https://github.com/NickGeneva/cfgrib.git@6a9af3173d7050b5fa5d221755f97e6ecb8c3433
jax[cuda13]==0.10.0
jaxlib==0.10.0
xarray==2026.2.0
pandas==2.3.3
